description: Check the status of a DPX integration verification session. Polls Base mainnet for receipt of the $0.01 USDC handshake payment. Returns "pending" until payment is detected on-chain, then "verified" with the txHash and a Basescan explorer link. Poll every 10–15 seconds after sending the payment.
name: integration.status

explorer.description: Basescan URL for the verification transaction.

txHash.description: Transaction hash of the $0.01 payment. Present when verified.

verifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp of on-chain confirmation. Present when status is "verified".
